# Al-Tayyab Global Consultants

> Kashmir's most trusted MBBS consultancy for Bangladesh. Free consultation — your fees go directly to the college, never to us.

Al-Tayyab Global Consultants is a Srinagar-based educational consultancy that helps Kashmiri students get admitted to BMDC-approved, NMC-listed MBBS colleges in Bangladesh. Founded in 2015. 650+ students placed.

## What we do

- Guide Kashmiri students into MBBS programs in Bangladesh
- Connect students directly with college admission officers in Dhaka
- Students pay fees directly to the college's official bank account — we never handle money
- Free consultation (we earn a referral from the college, not from students)

## Key facts

- MBBS total cost: ₹30–35 L for the full 5-year program + 1-year internship
- All colleges are BMDC-approved and NMC-listed (valid for FMGE/NEXT and practice in India)
- 10+ government colleges, 25+ private colleges in Bangladesh
- Eligibility: NEET qualified, 50%+ in Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Class 12)
- Duration: 5 years MBBS + 1 year internship
- Language: English medium
- Session: 2026–27
